name: Ri Jin Hyok

attribution.legal_posture: Designated under E.O. 13722; Foreign Trade Bank representative; Treasury reported that he facilitated transactions worth over $350,000 in U.S. dollars, Chinese yuan, and euros on behalf of an unnamed Foreign Trade Bank front company; administrative sanctions designation, with the record carrying no criminal charge or conviction.

caveats: The record covers an administrative designation and Treasury-reported conduct; it carries no criminal charge or adjudicated finding. Foreign Trade Bank is a source-explicit representative and OFAC linked-to relationship. The primary source leaves the Foreign Trade Bank front company associated with the over-$350,000 aggregate unidentified. Zhuhai, China supplies designation-era exact-entry context; residence, continued presence, and present location require separate evidence. The record excludes company identity, account, payment, counterparty, transaction, wallet, passport, birth, nationality, gender, contact, precise address, and other sensitive selectors.
Administrative sanctions listing; the record carries no criminal conviction.

identity_boundary: Ri Jin Hyok, listed by OFAC as RI, Jin Hyok with the alternate romanization RI, Chin-hyo'k, is the Foreign Trade Bank representative described in Treasury's November 2025 sanctions action.
